title: 源端用 getTextBounds 取文字高时，规格映射到 actualBoundingBox，不列字体行框

triggers.read: 源端自绘 View 用 Paint.getTextBounds(text, start, end, rect) 后取 rect.height() 定行高、行距或自适应字号
triggers.wrong: 映射行写 getTextBounds.height → fontBoundingBoxAscent + fontBoundingBoxDescent，或把 fontBoundingBox* 列为候选、注「字段待实测（对照字体 hhea）」，验收条目不断言字段

scope: 规格提取阶段写 Paint 文字度量到 TextMetrics 的映射行时

how.text: 先按源 API 判断度量层级：getTextBounds / Rect.height() 是所测字符的墨迹紧包围盒，Paint.ascent / descent / getFontMetrics 才是字体级行框
映射行写成：getTextBounds 高度 → Math.ceil(m.actualBoundingBoxAscent) + Math.ceil(m.actualBoundingBoxDescent)（m = ctx.measureText(所测子串)），写清所测子串（text 的 start 到 end）和取整方式，不把 fontBoundingBox* 列为候选

values.value: getTextBounds 返回包住所有字符的最小矩形，原点隐含在 (0,0)（基线起点）
Paint.ascent() 按当前字体和字号返回基线以上的距离（负值）
values.meaning: 字体级度量，和 getTextBounds 不是一个层级

values.value: actualBoundingBoxAscent / actualBoundingBoxDescent：textBaseline 指示的水平线到渲染文字矩形边界顶部 / 底部的距离
values.meaning: 目标端的墨迹级度量，对应 getTextBounds

values.value: fontBoundingBoxAscent / fontBoundingBoxDescent：到所有字体渲染文字最高矩形边界顶部 / 底部的距离
values.meaning: 字体级行框，不对应 getTextBounds

values.value: 两项各自 Math.ceil，对应 Skia 的 roundOut 外扩取整；字体行框约比墨迹包围盒大 1.4 倍
values.meaning: 取整方式和用错字段时的偏差量级

why: 用字体行框代替墨迹包围盒，行高偏大约 1.4 倍，等距排开后标签与数值脱开、组间留白被吃掉

probe.note: 映射行把 getTextBounds 映射到了字体级 fontBoundingBox，应改为 actualBoundingBox

siblings_checked: 搜 measureText(text: string): TextMetrics：鸿蒙 SDK ets/component/canvas.d.ts 里只在 CanvasRenderer 上，CanvasRenderingContext2D 和 OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D 继承它，无另外的同族接口

refs.what: getTextBounds 是包住所有字符的最小矩形
refs.quote: Return in bounds (allocated by the caller) the smallest rectangle that * encloses all of the characters, with an implied origin at (0,0).
Return the distance above (negative) the baseline (ascent) based on the * current typeface and text size.
Double, the distance from the horizontal line indicated by the textBaseline property to the top of *    the rectangular boundary of the rendered text.
Double, the distance from the horizontal line indicated by the textBaseline property to the bottom of *    the rectangular boundary of the rendered text.
Double, distance from the horizontal line indicated by the textBaseline property to the top of the *    highest rectangle boundary of all fonts rendering text.
Double, distance from the horizontal line indicated by the textBaseline property to the bottom of the *   rectangular boundary of all fonts rendering text.
